correctness.rationale: The classical Pfaffian multiplicity formula gives D_{n,s}=∏_{1≤i≤j≤s}(n-s-1+i+j)/(i+j), with extended ambient endpoints. Factorial cancellation yields the adjacent ratio D_{n,s}/D_{n,s-2}=∏_{k=-(s-1)}^{s-1}(n+k)/[(2s)! C_{s-1}]; its quotient at s+2 gives exact second ratio [(n²-s²)(n²-(s+1)²)]/[16(2s-1)(2s+1)²(2s+3)]. Independent Sympy factored Q_n(s+2)-Q_n(s) = -4(2s+3)(n²+255s²+765s+701), strictly negative for admissible positive n,s, forcing at most one sign change from log-convex to log-concave. Dividing numerator/denominator by n⁴ yields (1-theta²)²/(256theta⁴), crossing one at 1/sqrt(17). Independent exact fractional degree and curvature comparisons checked 324 cases for 4≤n≤40; symbolic proof covers all.

value.rationale: Pfaffian skew-symmetric rank loci form a natural canonical nested family of projective varieties; their enumerative degrees admit a coherent exact curvature phase portrait. One-transition behavior and sharp asymptotic threshold reveal cross-rank geometric structure, not a one-number substitution or recomputation of known multiplicities.

limitations: Only standard projective skew-symmetric rank loci, proper nonzero ranks plus an ambient endpoint. No arbitrary Pfaffian/Schubert degeneracy loci and no universal sign exactly at critical scaling.
